newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, U.S to reopen insurance talks on Sept 18-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan, U.S to reopen insurance talks on Sept 18-MOF.

text.p: Japan and the United States plan to reopen working-level insurance talks in Tokyo on September 18, an official at Japan's Finance Ministry said on Friday.

The finance ministry separately said in a statement that Shuichiro Hamanaka, deputy secretary-general of the ministry's International Finance Bureau will hold talks with Deputy Assistant U.S. Trade Representative James Southwick.

The two nations ended their latest round of marathon talks in Vancouver, Canada, in late July without a solution to their insurance dispute over how to deregulate Japan's $382 billion insurance market.

Washington has accused Tokyo of reneging on an agreement by moving to deregulate its "third sector" niche market, including such cover as personal accident and health care insurance, in which foreign firms have a strong foothold, before opening its primary life and casualty markets.
